title: Decision framing
activation: should we go with this or that
we have argued about this for weeks, settle it
lay out the options so leadership can choose
is it worth delaying launch to fix this
we keep going back and forth on this
a real choice that will carry weight: build, buy, commit, reorganize, or forgo, and reversing has a cost
build ourselves or buy a vendor, pick a database, choose between architectures, which sequencing of investments to commit to
frame the choice with trade-offs and recommend one with the strongest objection stated
standDown: the decision is already made, help execute the rollout
only one viable option, just do it
a cheap reversible pick, any of these, easy to change
a scheduling or factual question with nothing to decide
outcomes: a decision record with options, baseline, reversibility, objection, pre-mortem
inputs: the alternatives in play and what each would cost
minimumEvidence: every load-bearing claim cites what it rests on or is marked unverified
escalation: the recommendation is presented as the person's decision to make, never applied
when stakes are unclear one question is asked rather than guessed
